note: Season 0 rounds. Lock is always release minus 48 hours, except behavioral series (wikipedia), which lock before the measured week begins because their outcome data publishes daily. Times are UTC. release_estimated=true means the pollster does not preannounce an exact time; if a wave slips, the round resolves on the next published wave. New weekly rounds are appended by the refresh cron.
